name: MSM Malaysia Holdings Berhad
summary: MSM Malaysia Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, produces, markets, and sells refined sugar products in Malaysia and internationally. The company operates through its subsidiaries, Malayan Sugar Manufacturing Company Berhad in Prai, Penang, and Kilang Gula Felda Perlis Sdn Bhd in Chuping, Perlis, offering white refined sugar, soft brown sugar, and molasses, as well as rubber and palm oil plantation operations. It exports its products to Vietnam, Myanmar, China, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, Bangladesh, Taiwan, New Zealand, and Indonesia. The company was founded in 1964, is a subsidiary of FGV Holdings Berhad, and is headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
